dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags and help example are present, but neither required flag conflict is enforced.
evidence: product.diff: adds StringArrayVar for --field and --field-id and preserves each slice order
product.diff: runList resolves selections, then writes exporter output without rejecting field selections

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical names, and actionable unknown-field errors are implemented; ambiguous IDs retain response order rather than being sorted.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold and sorts unknown-name candidates
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous match IDs are appended without sort.Strings

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The normal path reuses definitions returned with ProjectItems, but does not fetch later field-definition pages when needed.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests fields(first: $firstFields) with firstFields = LimitMax
product.diff: runList resolves only project.Fields.Nodes; it never calls ProjectFields or pagination
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectFields and paginateAttributes provide field pagination but are unreachable from the added selection path

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value variants are rendered and matched by field ID, but values are returned raw with no CR/LF normalization.
evidence: product.diff: projectFieldValue handles date, iteration, labels, number, select, text, milestone, pull requests, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: projectFieldValue returns empty string when no matching or recognized value exists
product.diff: no rendering branch removes carriage returns or replaces newlines

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: The reachable command path resolves selected fields before rendering, appends canonical headers, and appends one ID-matched cell per selected field for every item.
evidence: product.diff: runList calls resolveSelectedFields then printResults
product.diff: printResults appends field.Name headers and projectFieldValue(i, field.ID()) for each item

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup failures occur before exporter/table output and query errors propagate; the small focused diff uses existing query types and shared resolvers, though required validation gaps remain.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields returns errors before exporter.Write or printResults
product.diff: implementation uses queries.ProjectField, FieldValueNodes, ResolveFieldByName, and ResolveFieldByID

criticalGaps: --field and --field-id can be combined, and field selections are not rejected with formatted/JSON output.
Selected fields beyond the first returned field-definition page cannot be resolved because no field pagination is invoked.
Rendered values are not sanitized for carriage returns and newlines.
Ambiguous field-ID candidates are not deterministically sorted.
